title: Metamorphosis II
identity: Charles Smith, Metamorphosis II, assigned as Dorn DORN0150 for soprano saxophone solo. The searched Dorn catalogs did not confirm DORN0150; DORN1518 appears separately as English horn and piano by Charles W. Smith. The two queue entries may be duplicated, miskeyed, or distinct works/editions; evidence is insufficient to decide.

evidence.claim: Assignment snapshot records Groth product DORN0150 and a composer-name discrepancy: catalog composer Charles Smith, product-page composer Charles W. Smith.
Searches for the title and product number did not return a primary Dorn record or a reliable saxophone performance.
Dorn’s Nov. 2024 and Apr. 2025 catalog search results list DORN1518 Metamorphosis II in English horn and piano, not saxophone; the catalog scans are search-index text and no score was found.
The assigned DORN0150 soprano-solo record was not found in the searched Dorn catalogs.
On printed page 33 (PDF page 31), Charles Smith appears as transcriber of a Mozart wind-duet anthology. This is unrelated to either queued Metamorphosis II record and does not resolve their identity.
